## Summary

Full Stack Developer with 1+ year at a software house, building multi-tenant, offline-first, and financial-transaction systems (POS, payroll, escrow, ledgers) with Laravel, Svelte 5, PostgreSQL, and Redis. Handles the full cycle from client requirements to architecture, sprint planning, and deployment. Secondary experience in Solidity smart contracts and Web3 applications.

## Selected Projects

### Veilfi (Completed)
Decentralized yield aggregation platform built with smart contracts and zero-knowledge circuits. Users earn yield across multiple DeFi strategies while preserving privacy through ZK proofs. Ensures secure fund management, verifiable compliance, and trustless operation without centralized intermediaries.
- Technologies: Solidity, ZK Circuits, Web3

### Velipe (Completed)
Decentralized document verification platform built with smart contracts and a Web3 frontend. Enables secure issuance and validation of digital documents on-chain using IPFS for immutable storage. Eliminates reliance on centralized authorities through blockchain-enforced authenticity.
- Technologies: Solidity, IPFS, Web3

### SathaFly (Completed)
Web-based dApp for purchasing flight tickets as NFTs using IDRX tokens. Smart contract automatically executes refunds for flight delays or cancellations without manual claims.
- Technologies: Solidity, IDRX, NFT, Web3, ERC-20

### Gasan (In Progress)
AI-driven fraud prevention platform for community savings (arisan). Mitigates default risks through predictive analytics and automated escrow disbursements. Ensures transparent fund management without reliance on manual verification.
- Technologies: Python, FastAPI, Escrow

### June Label (Completed)
Modern e-commerce website with premium product gallery managed via Filament Admin Panel. Integrated cart and checkout system for seamless end-to-end shopping experience. Live at https://junelabel.id.
- Technologies: Laravel, Inertia.js, React, Filament

### SiPandu-DM (Completed)
Engineered an offline-first mobile application with a strict 3-tier architecture to monitor Type 2 Diabetes risk at the community level. Implemented robust local data synchronization using the Outbox Pattern and Isar NoSQL for reliable operation in low-connectivity environments. Designed a secure backend API with Python, integrating AES-256-GCM encryption and Role-Based Access Control to ensure medical data confidentiality and regulatory compliance.
- Technologies: Flutter, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Drift, Docker

### Billet (Completed)
Built an on-chain smart ticketing protocol on Base Layer 2 utilizing ERC-1155 to mitigate scalping through trustless escrow and strict secondary market restrictions. Architected on-chain price ceiling enforcement and conditional royalty routing (ERC-2981) to automatically restrict peer-to-peer transfers and manage event organizer revenues. Designed a decoupled Web3 architecture integrating smart contracts, a Ponder-based indexer for efficient GraphQL event querying, and a Next.js/Wagmi frontend.
- Technologies: Solidity, Next.js, Foundry, Base L2, Ponder

### Solvio (Completed)
Enterprise multi-tenant SaaS operational platform unifying GPS selfie attendance with anti-spoofing watermark, offline-first POS cash register, and automated payroll calculation across multi-branch retail outlets. Powered by Laravel Octane on FrankenPHP for sub-millisecond API responses and Svelte 5 frontend SPAs.
- Technologies: Svelte 5, Laravel 11, Octane / FrankenPHP, PostgreSQL
